title: 绝句（江碧鸟逾白）
author: 杜甫
intro: Four short lines with four bright colours — green river, white birds, blue hills, flame-red flowers — and then a sigh: another spring is passing, and when will I go home?
analysis: 这首小诗前两句像一幅色彩鲜艳的画：江水碧绿，衬得水上的鸟更白；山是青的，衬得山上的花红得像要燃烧起来。碧、白、青、红四种颜色互相映衬，“逾”（更加）和“欲燃”（好像要烧起来）两个词让画面活了起来。可是后两句一转：今年的春天眼看又要过去了，哪一天才是我回家的日子呢？春光越美，越让在外的人想家——这叫“以乐景写哀情”，用美好的景色来写悲伤的心情，反差让思念更深。全诗只有二十个字，用的都是学过的常用字，很适合初学者背诵。
analysisEn: The first two lines are a painting in bright colours: the river is jade-green, which makes the birds over it look even whiter; the hills are blue-green, which makes the flowers on them so red they seem about to catch fire. Green, white, blue and red set each other off, and the words 逾 (“even more”) and 欲燃 (“about to burn”) bring the picture to life. Then the last two lines turn: this spring, too, is passing before my eyes — which day will be the year I go home? The more beautiful the spring, the more a person far from home misses it — and Du Fu, a war refugee in Chengdu for years, had watched several such springs go by. Chinese critics call this “using a happy scene to write a sad feeling”: the contrast makes the longing deeper. With just twenty characters, almost all common ones, it is a perfect poem for beginners to learn by heart.
background: Du Fu (712–770) wrote this in spring 764 in Chengdu, where he had lived for several years as a refugee from the wars in the north. The poem is the second of a pair of quatrains.
pronunciation: 逾 yú；看 kàn（眼看）；欲燃 yù rán。
version: 采用统编小学语文教材文本。原为《绝句二首》的第二首。

lines.lit: The river is jade-green, the birds even whiter;
lines.en: Green river — the birds look whiter still;

lines.lit: the hills are blue-green, the flowers about to burn.
lines.en: blue hills — the flowers seem on fire.

lines.lit: This spring, I watch it pass again;
lines.en: Another spring slips by before my eyes.

lines.lit: what day will be the year I return?
lines.en: When will the year come that I go home?

words.note: 古义“更加”；今天多是“超过”，如“逾期”。
古诗里的“青山”是青绿色。

words.en: about to; as if going to
to watch; (here) right before one’s eyes

imagery.name: 江
imagery.zh: 碧绿的江水是画面的底色，衬托白鸟，也让人想到流去的时光。
imagery.en: The jade-green river is the backdrop that makes the birds whiter — and water flowing away like time.

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 白鸟在碧水上更显洁白，自由自在，诗人却回不了家。
imagery.en: White birds over green water, free to fly — while the poet cannot go home.

imagery.name: 花
imagery.zh: 红得像火的花是春天最盛的时候，越美越让人想到春天又要过去。
imagery.en: Flowers red as fire are spring at its peak — the more beautiful, the clearer that spring is passing.
